study: Exact static geometry of the already identified inward vacancy tripod, archived L20 validation only
scope: Retrospective explanation of a selected motif, not replication, a future prediction, or a new discovery test. No teacher, shell target, model fitting, test rows, beta index 6, dynamics, simulation or trajectory files are inputs. Does not change the mechanism prediction, its sign, threshold, cohorts or primary estimand.
fold: For indices 0, 7, 9 only use all 2048 rows in l20_pairs.partition(index)[0][1]. Authenticate the compressed endpoint and its receipt, read validation rows in increasing file order and restore native split order. ZIP decompression may pass excluded byte ranges internally, but only selected row payloads are requested and converted to arrays. All 8000 periodic lattice centers of each validation parent are counted exactly once per frame; enumerate all eight frames. Axes x,y,z correspond to last, penultimate, antepenultimate spatial array dimensions.
definitions: c is the corner, not the cube center. At corner (-1,-1,-1) inward is (+++); all sign triples s choose one of each opposite pair. v=1 if the species is 0 (vacant), k=m_c counts OCCUPIED nearest neighbors including around a vacant center, n=6-k. d_i=v(c+e_i)-v(c-e_i). b counts axes with two vacancies, q=sum_i d_i^2 counts singly vacant axes. Exactly 2 T_s=n+s.d. Under O_h about c, n/2 is a scalar (A1g) and d a polar vector odd under inversion (T1u); in the sign-frame Walsh expansion the quadratic and cubic coefficients vanish. This statement is about the tripod count, not thresholds of it, teacher states, the entire block or a projective representation of the teacher.
sum_rules: Each axis has 0,1,2 vacancies. Thus n=2b+q; b in [max(0,n-3),floor(n/2)]. T_s+T_-s=n. The perpendicular-pair vacancy count equals C(n,2)-b, since each distinct vacancy pair is either opposite or perpendicular.

With s uniform over all 8 octants independently of the shell, T_s=b+Binomial(q,1/2). Doubly vacant axes always contribute 1, singly vacant axes contribute one fair bit each. Hence P(T=0)=1[b=0] 2^-q and P(T=3)=1[b+q=3] 2^-q. Conditional on k, all four probabilities, not just the tails, are fixed by the measured distribution of q (equivalently b). Mean=n/2, variance=q/4 and fourth central moment=(3q^2-2q)/16 conditional on q,n. A mixture at fixed n averages those central moments directly. This accounting identity is not an independent prediction of order or of a spatial correlation.

Fixed-n permutation null: all C(6,n) placements equally likely conditional on the center label and k. Single-site vacancy probability n/6; each unordered distinct pair has joint occupancy n(n-1)/30; signed within-axis difference has mean 0 and second moment n(6-n)/15; all cross signed second moments vanish. E[b]=n(n-1)/10. P(T=t)=C(3,t) C(3,n-t)/C(6,n). Covariance of two distinct sites for indicators of vacancy under the null is -n(6-n)/180, not zero. No independent Bernoulli or global reshuffle approximation.

Refined cubic-orbit comparison: conditional on observed n and b, mix the 48 signed axis permutations of the six fixed neighbors. Equivalent to uniform on masks in that (n,b) orbit, since the numbers of empty/single/double axes are then fixed. This preserves antipodal correlations and the entire octant-averaged count law exactly; equality for fixed lab-frame components need not hold in a finite sample. It is not a model of correlations between distinct centers.
estimands: Report moments by center species (vacancy=0,A=1,B=2) and k=0..6, plus a pooled row weighting by the actual count of every measured (species,k) stratum at each beta, not a uniform average over occupied strata. Fixed-frame d_i^2, d_i*d_j, d_i^2*d_j^2 and the octant-averaged mass function and centered moments accompany b, q and pooled shell-pair joint probabilities/covariances for opposite versus perpendicular neighbors. Covariances use n/6 as conditional one-site mean after cubic rotation; pooling averages within-k covariances without adding between-k covariance. Counts identify which strata contribute to departures from six-slot permutation exchangeability. A departure describes angular packing relative to this null; it is not evidence that ordinary finite-shell glass structure is insufficient.
uncertainty: A uniform site in a uniform validation parent is the sampling unit for the estimand; equal parent volumes. A stratum estimate is a ratio of pooled response sums to pooled site counts, not an equal weighting of possibly empty parent strata. Delete one whole parent at a time in numerator and denominator and use the paired difference of observed minus each parent-matched conditional null. Pointwise two-sided t intervals with jackknife SE; no intervals for fewer than eight supporting parents. Sites, signed frames, axes, and neighbor pairs are never treated as replicates. Temperature panels show separate beta cohorts, not one-to-one paired temperatures. The administrative validation split was previously used, intervals are descriptive and not multiplicity-adjusted.
artifacts: parent-masks.npz gives exact uint16 counts (validation parent, center species, six-bit vacancy mask) by index; bit order (+x,-x,+y,-y,+z,-z), least significant first. Native row ids, chain_seed and chain_id recorded. responses.csv gives denominator and parent support for each ratio, observed, permutation-null and refined cubic-null means and paired differences with uncertainty. summary.json gives checks, hashes, inputs and temperature comparisons. vacancy-dipole.png shows temperature and stratum dependence. No large species or test arrays are exported.
